I could not find the commit or change for O3-5993 in Falkon, so I can't name the fix. What I found is the code that produces the placeholder text, plus a commit that is the likeliest origin of it but is not linked to this ticket.

**The placeholder is produced in two places, both with the same pattern:**
- `openmrs-module-reporting/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/reporting/web/reports/RunReportFormController.java` (lines 114–128). When a required parameter has no value or expression, it calls `errors.rejectValue("userEnteredParams[" + parameterName + "]", "error.required", new Object[] { "This parameter" }, "{0} is required")` at line 124–125. The `"This parameter"` argument is what the user sees instead of the parameter's name. @file:{openmrs-module-reporting::omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/reporting/web/reports/RunReportFormController.java:114-128}
- `openmrs-module-reporting/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/reporting/web/reports/renderers/TextTemplateFormController.java` (lines 303–317). Same construct at line 313–314 for the Text Template renderer. @file:{openmrs-module-reporting::omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/reporting/web/reports/renderers/TextTemplateFormController.java:303-317}

The `error.required={0} is required` message template is at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/resources/messages.properties:60`. @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/resources/messages.properties:60-60}

**Possible origin, not confirmed:** commit `b9d38c98f323b7c5a7145c1c4c11681871400b58` ("fixed REPORT-246 - Display a more user-friendly message when required fields are blank 'report.userEnteredParams'", 2011). It is the only history entry about this message. It is REPORT-246, not O3-5993. Falkon's diff for that commit returned empty, so I could not confirm it introduced `"This parameter"`.

**Gaps:**
- No commit or ticket matched `O3-5993` in Falkon (content grep and commit-message search both came back empty).
- The current code still passes `"This parameter"`, so the parameter name is not shown at HEAD. Either the O3-5993 fix lives in a repository or branch Falkon does not index, or it was never merged here.
- I did not search the O3 frontend repositories for the admin report-run UI. The admin tools for reports may be the reporting module's JSP/controller pages, as cited above, but I have not checked that.
